# RECIPE30

> > Quick video recipes by Chef Joel Mielle featuring Italian classics, Asian cuisine, and restaurant-quality meals in 30 minutes or less

RECIPE30 is a culinary video platform created by Chef Joel Mielle, specializing in approachable home cooking with professional techniques. The site features authentic Italian pasta dishes, Thai curries, French desserts, and classic comfort foods, all designed to be completed within 30 minutes.

## Key Topics

- Chef Joel Mielle
- 30-minute meals
- Video recipes
- Italian pasta (Carbonara, Fettuccine Alfredo)
- Chicken recipes
- Restaurant-style cooking
- Cream sauces
- Thai red curry
- Quick meals
- Parmesan and Pecorino cheese
- Pancetta and Guanciale
- Asian cooking techniques
- Condiments and sauces
- Pork tenderloin
- French desserts

## Italian Classics

- [Authentic Spaghetti Carbonara](https://recipe30.com/spaghetti-carbonara.html): Authentic Italian spaghetti carbonara with pancetta or guanciale
- [Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo](https://recipe30.com/chicken-fettuccinne-alfredo.html): Italian chicken fettuccine alfredo inspired by Alfredo Di Lelio of Rome

## Chicken Dishes

- [Thai Red Curry Chicken](https://recipe30.com/thai-red-curry-chicken.html): Thai red curry chicken recipe by Chef Joel Mielle under 30 minutes
- [Balsamic Chicken Breast](https://recipe30.com/balsamic-chicken-breast.html): One-pan balsamic chicken with honey glaze and Italian herbs
- [Roasted Tarragon Chicken with Rich Onion and Garlic Gravy](https://recipe30.com/roast-tarragon-chicken-with-rich-onion-and-garlic-gravy.html): Fine dining roasted tarragon chicken with onion garlic wine gravy
- [Chicken With Camembert Cheese](https://recipe30.com/chicken-camembert.html): Panko-crusted chicken stuffed with Normandy Camembert and chive mousse
- [Super Crunch Chicken Tenderloins](https://recipe30.com/super-crunch-chicken-tenderloins.html): Kid-friendly panko and Parmesan crusted chicken tenderloins recipe
- [The Best Caesar Salad with Grilled Chicken](https://recipe30.com/the-best-caesar-salad-with-grilled-chicken.html): Caesar salad with grilled chicken and homemade dressing recipe
- [BBQ Chicken Lollypops](https://recipe30.com/bbq-chicken-lollypops.html): BBQ chicken lollypops made with frenched drumsticks for grilling

## Restaurant-Style Mains

- [Pork Fillet Mushroom Sauce (Tenderloin)](https://recipe30.com/pork-fillet-mushroom-sauce-tenderloin.html): Restaurant-style pork tenderloin with creamy mushroom sauce recipe
- [Roast Duck With Cherries](https://recipe30.com/roast-duck-with-cherries.html): Festive roast duck with cherries and port wine sauce for Christmas
- [The Ultimate Steak Sandwich](https://recipe30.com/the-ultimate-steak-sandwich.html): Ultimate steak sandwich with caramelized onions and tomato chutney

## Sauces & Condiments

- [Extra Tasty Luscious Chicken Gravy Recipe](https://recipe30.com/chicken-gravy.html): Homemade roasted chicken gravy recipe with Chef Joel Mielle
- [Basil Aioli Sauce](https://recipe30.com/basil-aoli.html): Basil aioli garlic sauce recipe for seafood accompaniment
- [Super Smooth Avocado Mayonnaise](https://recipe30.com/mayonnaise.html): Homemade avocado oil mayonnaise with emulsification technique

## Desserts & Baking

- [Mystere au Chocolat](https://recipe30.com/mystere-au-chocolat.html): French chocolate ice cream dessert with Grand Marnier and hazelnuts
- [Easy Apple Strudel](https://recipe30.com/easy-apple-strudel.html): Austrian apple strudel with filo pastry and Golden Delicious apples
- [Yogurt Cake That Will Amaze You](https://recipe30.com/amazing-yogurt-cake.html): Simple moist Greek yogurt cake recipe for quick baking

## Soups & Light Meals
